buff_ahrip_tooltip:
Killing minions or monsters grants Ahri an Essence Fragment. After obtaining @MaxStacks@ Fragments, Ahri consumes them to restore @MinionHeal@ Health.

When Ahri scores a takedown against an enemy champion within @TakedownWindow@ seconds of damaging them, she feasts upon their Essence, restoring @ChampionHeal@ Health.
item_3057_tooltip:
Spellblade {{ Item_Cooldown }}
After using an Ability, your next Attack deals @SpellbladeDamage@ bonus physical damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.
item_3145_tooltip:
Revved {{ Item_Cooldown }}
Damaging a champion deals @DamageAmount@ bonus magic damage.
item_3153_tooltip:
Mist's Edge
Attacks deal {{ Item_Melee_Ranged_Split_Dynamic }} of enemy's current Health as bonus physical damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}.

Clawing Shadows {{Item_Cooldown}}
Attacking a champion 3 times Slows them by @MoveSpeedMod*-100@% for @MoveSpeedDuration@ second.
item_6672_tooltip:
Bring It Down
Every third Attack deals @DamageAmount@ bonus physical damage {{ Item_Keyword_OnHit }}, increased up to @MaximumDamage@ based on their missing Health.
passive_aatroxpassive_tooltip:
Aatrox's Attacks deal an additional @PDamage@ max Health magic damage and restore @PHealingRatio*100@% of damage dealt as Health, reduced to @PHealingMinionMod*100@% against minions. This effect has a @PCooldown@ second cooldown.

Attack and Ability hits against champions and large jungle monsters reduce this effect's cooldown by 2 seconds. Hits with the edge of The Darkin Blade reduce it by 4 seconds instead.
spell_aatroxe_tooltip:
Passive: Aatrox heals for @TotalEVamp@ of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.
spell_aatroxq_tooltip: Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing <physicalDamage>@QDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly <status>Knocked Up</status> and they take <physicalDamage>@QEdgeDamage@</physicalDamage> instead. This Ability can be <recast>Recast</recast> twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.
spell_aatroxr_tooltip:
Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for @RMinionFearDuration@ seconds and gaining @RMovementSpeedBonus*100@% Move Speed decaying over @RDuration@ seconds. He also gains @RTotalADAmp*100@% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by @RHealingAmp*100@% for the duration.

Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by @RExtension@ seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect.
spell_aatroxw_tooltip: Aatrox fires a chain, <status>Slowing</status> the first enemy hit by @WSlowPercentage*-100@% for @WSlowDuration@ seconds and dealing <physicalDamage>@WDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage>. Champions and large jungle monsters have @WSlowDuration@ seconds to leave the impact area or be <status>Pulled</status> back to the center and damaged again for the same amount.
spell_ahrifoxfire_tooltip: Ahri releases 3 fox-fires that seek nearby enemies and deal <magicDamage>@SingleFireDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, reduced to <magicDamage>@MultiFireDamage@ damage</magicDamage> beyond the first. She also gains <speed>@MovementSpeed*100@% Move Speed</speed> decaying over @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds.
spell_ahriorbofdeception_tooltip: Ahri throws then pulls back her orb, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> on the way out and <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ true damage</trueDamage> on the way back.
spell_ahriseduce_tooltip: Ahri blows a kiss that <status>Charms</status> the first enemy hit for @CharmDuration@ seconds and deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
spell_ahritumble_tooltip:
Ahri nimbly dashes, firing @RMaxTargetsPerCast@ essence bolts at nearby enemies, prioritizing champions. These bolts deal @RCalculatedDamage@ magic damage each. Spirit Rush can be Recast up to 2 more times within @RRecastWindow@ seconds.

Consuming a champion's Essence with Essence Theft during this period extends the recast window by up to @PDurationExtension@ seconds and grants an additional recast of Spirit Rush (up to @RMaxCasts@ stored).
spell_anniee_tooltip:
Annie grants an ally champion @ShieldBlockTotal@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and @MoveSpeedCalc@ Decaying Move Speed for @MovementSpeedDuration@ seconds. While the shield holds, enemies who hit the shielded ally with an Attack or Ability receive @DamageReturn@ magic damage once per shield.

Tibbers always gains the effects of Molten Shield when summoned.
spell_anniepassive_tooltip:
After using 4 Abilities, Annie's next damaging Ability Stuns for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.
spell_annieq_tooltip: Annie hurls a fireball, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>. If the target dies, Annie refunds the Mana cost and reduces the Cooldown by 50%.
spell_annier_tooltip:
Passive: Annie gains @RPercentPenBuff*100@% Magic Penetration.

Annie summons her bear Tibbers, dealing @InitialBurstDamage@ magic damage. For the next @TibbersLifetime@ seconds, Tibbers burns nearby enemies for @TibbersAuraDamage@ magic damage per second.

Tibbers becomes enraged when summoned, if Annie stuns an enemy champion, and if Annie dies. When enraged, Tibbers gains 275% Attack Speed and 100% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.

Recast: Manually issue orders to Tibbers.
spell_anniew_tooltip: Annie projects a wave of fire, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>.
spell_garene_tooltip:
Garen rapidly spins his sword for @Duration@ seconds, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage @f1@ times over the duration. The nearest enemy takes @NearestEnemyBonus*100@% increased damage. Champions hit by @StacksToShred@ strikes lose @ShredAmount*100@% Armor for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

Recast: Garen ends this Ability early.
spell_garenpassive_tooltip: Garen regenerates <healing>@RegenCalc@ max Health</healing> every 5 seconds if he has not been damaged or hit with enemy Abilities in the last @DamageTimer@ seconds.
spell_garenq_tooltip:
Garen removes all Slowing effects on him and gains @MovementSpeedAmount*100@% Move Speed for @MovementSpeedDuration@ second(s).

His next Attack Silences for @SilenceDuration@ seconds and does @TotalDamage@ physical damage.
spell_garenr_tooltip: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to slay his enemy, dealing <trueDamage>@BaseDamage@ plus @ExecuteDamage*100@% missing Health true damage</trueDamage>.
spell_garenw_tooltip:
Passive: Garen has @ResistsForTooltip@ bonus Armor and @ResistsForTooltip@ bonus Magic Resist. Killing units permanently grants @ResistGainOnKillTooltip@ resists, up to a max of @ResistMax@.

Active: Garen steels his courage for @DRDuration@ seconds, reducing incoming damage by @DRPercent*100@%. He also gains @TotalShield@ Shield and @UpfrontTenacity*100@% Tenacity for @UpfrontDuration@ seconds.
spell_khazixpassive_tooltip:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional @TotalDamage@ magic damage and Slows by @SlowAmount*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.
